Signature corrected rather than the call site.

Same failure mode, different consequence. This replaced `getProviderCollectionSync(...).provider.capabilities` with `config.providerAuth`, so when that's missing or doesn't match `config.provider` the capability check is skipped entirely. A catalog-declared OAuth or local-auth provider outside the hard-coded `OAUTH_MANAGED_PROVIDERS` set then falls through to the missing-API-key path and gets reported as missing a key it never reads.

after `ensureSessionPersisted`, if `artifacts` is still missing the block falls through into `startResolvedSession` and can still replace the live entry. `ensureSessionPersisted` normally assigns artifacts or throws, so this is the rare null-return case, but that is exactly the orphaning path this PR is closing. would throwing here be safer than falling through?
